a:
Ventilation/perfusion lung scintigraphy – pulmonary embolism

Normal ventilation with large perfusion defects (V/Q MISMATCH) in both lungs = high probability of PE. Perfusion agent Tc-99m MAA.

q: Past practical exam (2011–2012 sets): answer the questions on the slide.
a:
Whole-body bone scintigraphy – disseminated bone metastases

Multiple asymmetric hot spots in the spine, ribs and pelvis (Tc-99m MDP/HMDP). Typical of prostate/breast cancer.
